sections.text_helper: Section 54.4.21 "Timer input XOR function" in chapter 54 (General-purpose timers (TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2690.
sections.section_content:
The TI1S bit in the TIMx_CR2 register, allows the input filter of channel 1 to be connected to
the output of an XOR gate, combining the three input pins tim_ti1, tim_ti2 and tim_ti3.
The XOR output can be used with all the timer input functions such as trigger or input
capture.
An example of this feature used to interface Hall sensors is given in Section53.3.29:
Interfacing with Hall sensors.
